A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
adjuvant radiotherapy is an essential part of the treatment of breast cancer and that local recurrences after surgery for breast carcinoma are associated with a poor prognosis.

the local recurrence rate in the ipsilateral breast is not a reliable surrogate for distant disease recurrence and that it is not an appropriate endpoint to be used in clinical trials of radiation therapy in early stage breast cancer....
